# The profile is a bet about the next year, evidenced by the last two

`sales.mm.icp_definition.past_evidence_future_bet` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> The profile is a bet about the next year, evidenced by the last two.
 Markets move, categories mature and competitors reprice. A profile validated on a market that has since consolidated describes a shape that no longer exists, and it will keep validating cleanly against history the whole time it is wrong about the future.
